dispositions.topic_text: Owner form body-read failure, session admission, and operations handoff
dispositions.what: What a surface does when its reading of a request body fails before it has a request to hand on — a form, a service request, an upload's head, sign-in included: hand the request on without values (admitted, restarting the idle time, refused at stage 1) or close the connection. Decided in the contracts and notes of serve_owner_request and serve_service_request, consistent with A13 rule 2 (same question as round-51 T3).
